description: Shared SLO summary cases for the slo-summary widget. The UI test (ui/src/features/insights/slo.test.ts) and the Go port test (internal/insights/slo_conformance_test.go) both run every case, so slo.ts and slo.go cannot diverge. Kinds: compile validates the config (expected.error is null when valid, else the error code), then compiles it (expected.query is the exact PromQL, and expected.error is query_too_long when the text is too long). step gives sloStep(start, end) in seconds. evaluate validates the config, evaluates result against it, and checks that every field present in expected matches the output. Fields absent from expected are not checked. Arrays must have the same length. Numbers match within 1e-9 relative. null means the output is null. Error codes are the SloErrorCode values in slo.ts. Windows: 5m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 6h, 1d, 3d and the period. Burn factors are spent * period / long seconds. Series are labelled slo_window and slo_part.
